name: WiseAI
alternateName: WiseAI - Master AI Before It Masters You
description: WiseAI is a mobile app that helps you learn AI and stay current in about 15 minutes a day: 25 personalized AI news picks daily, 500+ interactive lessons, 50+ AI tools compared, an AI chat tutor, AI duels, and an AI IQ test. Free to start.
releaseNotes: Pre-launch. Launching on iOS (final App Store review), Android to follow.
slogan: Master AI Before It Masters You
featureList: Personalized daily AI news: 25 updates from 30+ sources in a 60-second briefing
500+ interactive micro-lessons and adaptive learning paths
50+ AI tools compared with honest ratings, not paid placements
AI chat tutor powered by Gemini, grounded in the latest AI news
AI duels and a weekly Bronze-to-Diamond leaderboard
AI IQ test with a shareable score
Spaced-repetition review and certificates for finished paths
Daily missions, XP, streaks, and badges

audience.audienceType: Students, professionals in non-technical roles, developers, founders, and creators who want to stay AI-fluent

offers.name: Free
offers.description: Core experience free forever: unlimited daily AI news, unlimited lessons and paths, the full tool directory, daily missions, duels, streaks, and a taste of the AI chat tutor.

offers.name: WiseAI Pro
offers.description: Unlimited AI chat tutor, unlimited deep-read articles, advanced lessons and spaced repetition, certificates, and priority access. Pricing varies by region; see current pricing in the app.
